Country: United States
Partner: Airalo e-sim
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: Airalo is the world's first and largest eSIM marketplace, providing digital SIM (eSIM)
plans for travelers to access mobile data, and sometimes calls and texts, in over 200
countries and regions without needing a physical SIM card. To use Airalo, you download
the app, purchase a digital eSIM for your destination, install it on your compatible
device, and then connect to a mobile network upon arrival to get online.
Why we recommend: We recommend Airalo for its affordability, reliability, and convenience—offering seamless data access wherever you go. With Airalo’s eSIM technology, you can skip the hassle of physical SIM cards and avoid high roaming charges when traveling or moving abroad. Their plans are flexible and cover a wide range of destinations, making it easy to stay connected no matter where life takes you. Airalo is a trusted choice for newcomers and frequent travelers who want cost-effective and stress-free mobile data solutions.
How it helps: Airalo makes migration and travel easier by giving you instant, hassle-free mobile connectivity the moment you arrive in your new country. With their eSIM technology, you can skip the need for local SIM cards and avoid costly roaming charges, saving both time and money. Their wide range of global plans ensures you stay connected wherever you go, whether for work, family, or exploring your new surroundings. By providing reliable data access from day one, Airalo helps you settle in smoothly and stay connected without stress.
Link: https://airalo.pxf.io/7m4YGA

Country: United States
Partner: Visible
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: Visible is a U.S.-based mobile phone provider that offers unlimited data, calls, and texts on Verizon’s nationwide network.
Why we recommend: We recommend Visible for its simple, transparent pricing and reliable coverage without hidden fees. Their digital-first approach makes it easy to set up service quickly, without the complications of traditional mobile providers. With flexible, no-contract plans, you can choose the coverage that fits your lifestyle and budget. Visible is a trusted choice for newcomers who want affordable, dependable mobile connectivity from day one.
How it helps: Visible helps newcomers stay connected affordably with easy-to-set-up mobile plans and no long-term contracts. Their simple, digital-first approach allows you to activate service quickly, avoiding the hassle of traditional mobile providers. With transparent pricing and flexible options, you can choose a plan that fits your needs without unexpected fees. By providing reliable mobile service from day one, Visible ensures you can communicate, work, and stay connected as you settle into your new home.
Link: https://visible.pxf.io/WD7BJZ

Country: United States
Partner: Chime Bank
Category: Banking services
Overview: Chime is a U.S.-based financial technology company that provides online banking services with no hidden fees and user-friendly mobile access.
Why we recommend: We recommend Chime for its flexibility, fee-free banking, and helpful features like early direct deposit and automatic savings. Their user-friendly platform makes managing your finances simple and accessible, especially for newcomers adjusting to a new country. With no hidden fees and tools designed to help you save and track spending, Chime empowers you to take control of your money. It’s an ideal choice for anyone looking for a modern, convenient, and supportive banking solution.
How it helps: Chime supports newcomers by offering a simple, accessible way to manage money, build financial stability, and handle everyday banking needs from day one.
Link: https://chime.pxf.io/7aOqAd

Country: United States
Partner: Visitors Coverage
Category: Insurance
Overview: VisitorsCoverage is a leading travel insurance marketplace that helps travelers compare and purchase insurance plans tailored to their needs.
Why we recommend: We recommend VisitorsCoverage for its wide range of affordable plans, easy-to-use platform, and trusted customer support. Their policies are designed to meet the needs of newcomers, providing protection against medical emergencies, travel disruptions, and other unexpected events. The platform is intuitive, allowing you to compare and purchase coverage quickly without hassle. With reliable support and comprehensive options, VisitorsCoverage ensures you can travel or relocate with confidence and peace of mind.
How it helps: VisitorsCoverage helps newcomers stay protected by covering unexpected medical costs, travel disruptions, and emergencies during their move abroad. Their comprehensive insurance plans are designed to give you peace of mind, whether you’re relocating temporarily or planning a longer stay. With options tailored to different needs and budgets, you can ensure you’re covered for a variety of situations, from medical treatment to trip cancellations. By providing reliable protection, VisitorsCoverage allows you to focus on settling into your new environment without worrying about unforeseen expenses.
Link: https://visitorscoverageinc.pxf.io/Qjbxvz

Country: United States
Partner: Lemonade
Category: Insurance
Overview: Lemonade is a modern insurance provider that offers fast, affordable, and transparent renters insurance fully managed through a mobile app.
Why we recommend: We recommend Lemonade for its low-cost coverage, quick claims process, and commitment to customer-friendly service. Their digital-first platform makes it easy to purchase and manage insurance, saving you time and reducing complexity. With flexible policies tailored to renters and homeowners, Lemonade ensures you get the protection you need without overpaying. By combining efficiency with transparency and support, Lemonade provides newcomers peace of mind as they settle into their new home.
How it helps: Lemonade helps newcomers protect their belongings and gain peace of mind while settling into a new home. Their modern, digital-first insurance platform makes it easy to get coverage quickly and understand exactly what’s included. With flexible policies for renters or homeowners, you can tailor protection to fit your specific needs and budget. By covering potential losses from theft, damage, or accidents, Lemonade ensures you can focus on settling in without unnecessary worry.
Link: https://imp.i146998.net/xk33Vdlemonade

Country: United States
Partner: Figo pet
Category: Insurance
Overview: Figo is a pet insurance provider that offers customizable plans to cover veterinary care for cats and dogs.
Why we recommend: We recommend Figo for its affordable coverage, 24/7 virtual vet access, and easy-to-manage mobile app. Their comprehensive pet insurance plans are designed to keep pets healthy while minimizing unexpected veterinary costs. With a user-friendly platform and around-the-clock support, Figo makes it simple to manage claims and get professional advice whenever it’s needed. This combination of convenience, affordability, and reliable care makes Figo an excellent choice for newcomers who want to protect their furry family members.
How it helps: Figo helps newcomers care for their pets by reducing the financial stress of unexpected vet bills and ensuring pets stay healthy in a new country. Their comprehensive pet insurance plans cover a wide range of medical needs, from routine check-ups to emergencies, giving pet owners peace of mind. With easy online management and claims processing, Figo makes it simple to access care when it’s needed most. By providing reliable coverage, Figo allows you to focus on settling in while keeping your furry family members safe and healthy.
Link: https://figopetinsurance.com/?p=J9H5C

Country: United States
Partner: International Autosource
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: International AutoSource specializes in helping expatriates and newcomers purchase or lease vehicles without a U.S. credit history.
Why we recommend: We recommend International AutoSource for its tailored programs, competitive pricing, and expertise in working with people relocating internationally. Their team understands the unique challenges of moving to a new country and provides personalized support every step of the way. From selecting the right vehicle to financing and registration, International AutoSource simplifies the car-buying process for newcomers. With their reliable service and global experience, they make getting on the road in a new country fast, convenient, and stress-free.
How it helps: International AutoSource makes it easier for newcomers to secure reliable transportation, simplifying the car-buying process in a new country. They provide personalized support to help you find, finance, and register a vehicle quickly and efficiently. With access to a wide selection of cars and flexible financing options, newcomers can get on the road without unnecessary delays or stress. By handling the complexities of buying a car abroad, International AutoSource allows you to focus on settling into your new home with confidence and independence.
Link: https://go.intlauto.com/smooth-migration.html

Country: United States
Partner: Rentcars.com
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: Rentcars.com is a global online platform for renting cars that compares prices and
options from hundreds of car rental companies worldwide, offering customers a single
place to search, compare, and book vehicles. It functions as an aggregator, like other
travel booking sites, by compiling offers from many different car rental agencies to help
users find suitable cars for their trips. Users can search for cars by location and dates,
compare details, and then book through the Rentcars website or app.
Why we recommend: We recommend Rentcars for its wide selection, competitive rates, and flexibility in booking short- or long-term rentals. With access to hundreds of rental companies worldwide, Rentcars makes it easy to compare options and find the best vehicle for your needs. Their platform is user-friendly and transparent, helping you secure reliable transportation without hidden fees or unnecessary stress. Whether you need a car for a few days or several months, Rentcars provides convenient and affordable solutions to keep you moving.
How it helps: Rentcars helps newcomers stay mobile and independent by providing easy access to affordable rental cars upon arrival in a new country. Their platform allows you to compare a wide range of vehicles and rental options, ensuring you find the right fit for your needs and budget. With flexible booking periods and transparent pricing, you can secure reliable transportation without unexpected fees or complications. This convenience makes it easier to settle in, run errands, and explore your new surroundings with confidence.
Link: https://www.rentcars.com/en/?requestorid=9323&utm_source=smoothmigration.ca&utm_medium=afiliado

Country: United States
Partner: Wise
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a financial technology company that
provides online money transfer services and a multi-currency account for
individuals and businesses to send, spend, and receive money
internationally at low fees and the mid-market exchange rate. Key features
include high-speed, low-fee international transfers, a debit card for
spending in different currencies, and the ability to hold balances in over 40
currencies.
Why we recommend: We recommend Wise for its transparency, speed, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional banks. With clear, upfront fees and real exchange rates, Wise ensures you always know exactly what you’re paying for, without hidden charges. Their platform is designed for fast and secure international transfers, making it easier to move money across borders. Whether you’re sending funds to family, paying for services, or managing finances in multiple countries, Wise offers a simple and affordable solution you can trust.
How it helps: Wise helps newcomers move money internationally with ease, making it simpler to manage expenses and support family abroad during relocation. Their platform offers fast and secure transfers at low, transparent fees, ensuring you get the best value for your money. With real exchange rates and no hidden charges, Wise removes the uncertainty often associated with international banking. This makes managing finances across countries straightforward, allowing you to focus on settling into your new home with confidence.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: United States
Partner: Remitly
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Remitly is a digital remittance service that enables users to send money internationally
quickly, affordably, and securely, primarily, to family and friends. To use it, you create an
account on the Remitly website or mobile app, enter the recipient's details and desired
amount, select a delivery option like bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile money, and
pay for the transfer. Remitly guarantees on-time delivery or refunds your fees and uses
multiple security layers to protect transfers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Remitly for its fast transfers, multiple payout options, and reliable customer support. With Remitly, you can choose how your money is delivered—whether it’s direct to a bank account, as a cash pickup, or even delivered to a mobile wallet. Their secure platform ensures peace of mind, while competitive rates and speed make sending money abroad both affordable and convenient. For newcomers supporting family overseas, Remitly offers a trusted and flexible way to stay connected financially.
How it helps: Remitly helps newcomers easily send money to family or manage finances across borders, reducing stress during relocation. Their platform offers multiple delivery options, including bank deposits, cash pickups, and mobile wallets, providing flexibility to suit different needs. Transfers are fast, secure, and reliable, giving you peace of mind that your money will reach its destination safely. By simplifying international payments, Remitly allows you to focus on settling into your new country while staying connected financially with loved ones.
Link: https://remitly.tod8mp.net/Jr6DAv

Country: United States
Partner: XE
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Xe (xe.com) is a company that provides online currency conversion tools and
international money transfer services. You can use their website and app to convert
currencies at market rates, view historical charts and set rate alerts, and send money
directly to bank accounts or for cash pickup in other countries. To send money, you
register for an account, provide details of the recipient, confirm the payment amount,
choose a payment method (like a bank transfer or card), and process the transaction.
Why we recommend: We recommend XE for its reliability, transparent fees, and real-time currency tracking. Known worldwide as a trusted currency exchange and transfer service, XE makes moving money across borders simple and stress-free. Their platform provides live exchange rates, helping you make informed decisions and get the best value when sending or receiving funds. With secure transfers and a reputation for accuracy, XE is an excellent choice for newcomers managing international finances.
How it helps: XE helps newcomers manage cross-border finances efficiently, making it easier to pay bills, receive funds, or transfer money internationally. Their platform provides real-time exchange rates and transparent fees, ensuring you always know the true value of your transactions. With secure, reliable transfers, XE removes the stress and uncertainty often associated with moving money between countries. This allows newcomers to focus on settling into their new home while confidently handling their financial needs abroad.
Link: https://xe-money-transfer.sjv.io/9WNvNe

Country: United States
Partner: Sirelo (Experts in Moving)
Category: International Moving
Overview: Sirelo is an independent online platform for the moving industry that helps people find
and compare removal companies by providing customer reviews and free quotes for
international and national moves. Users can post their experiences with moving
companies to create a comprehensive database of reviews and can request up to five
free quotes from movers in their area. Sirelo's goal is to make the moving process more
transparent for consumers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Experts in Moving for their experience, reliable service, and personalized approach to international relocations. With years of expertise, they understand the complexities of moving abroad and are committed to making the process as smooth as possible. Their tailored solutions cover every detail—from packing and shipping to customs clearance—ensuring your belongings arrive safely. By combining professionalism with a personal touch, Experts in Moving helps take the stress out of your relocation journey.
How it helps: Experts in Moving helps newcomers transport their belongings safely and efficiently, reducing stress during the moving process. Their experienced team handles every step, from packing and loading to customs clearance and delivery, ensuring your items arrive intact and on time. With personalized solutions tailored to your specific relocation needs, they make even complex international moves manageable. By taking care of the logistics, Experts in Moving allows you to focus on settling into your new home with peace of mind.
Link: https://www.expertsinmoving.com/?so=a&ca=8ddabfceef8192200632f66a00293f9c
